items.title: Needham Says GameStop Is More Than a Meme Stock Now—and Sees 20% Upside
items.summary: GameStop (GME) stock has received a new Buy rating from Needham. The firm sees more value in the retailer’s shift toward collectibles and trading cards. It started coverage with a $33 price target, implying about 20% upside from current levels.
